job.title: Senior Software Engineer- Account Access & Controls
job.pay_full: $243,290 – $295,250 a year starting base pay (San Mateo HQ); full-time employees are also eligible for equity and benefits

details.about: The Access & Controls pod in Roblox's Safety organization owns the systems that tailor each user's platform experience by age, location, parental consents and more, so Roblox stays safe and compliant across many jurisdictions. Its services are among the highest-traffic at the company, in the hot path of nearly every user action across billions of accounts and millions of requests per second. The pod owns the full stack, from gRPC services to caching, data pipelines and client integrations.
duties: Design, build and operate high-throughput, low-latency services that shape what every Roblox user can see and do
Help set technical direction for feature access and user settings across Roblox
Onboard feature teams to the platforms and turn evolving regulatory requirements into consistent product behavior
Own reliability, performance and observability of systems nearly every feature depends on
Mentor engineers and contribute to knowledge sharing and project retros
needs: 5+ years of industry experience building and operating backend or distributed systems at scale
Strong fundamentals in service design, caching, data modeling and performance at millions of requests per second
A track record of leading projects from design through launch, including multi-team projects
BS, MS or PhD in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience
nice: Experience with authorization or access control systems, policy engines, configuration or feature-flag platforms, or regulatory compliance (age assurance, privacy, parental controls)
details.benefits: Starting base pay $243,290 – $295,250 a year for roles at the San Mateo headquarters; actual pay depends on background, experience, location and market factors and could fall outside the range. All full-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and benefits.
notes: Office roles are onsite Tuesday to Thursday, with Monday and Friday optional
For U.S. roles, Roblox may not be able to employ candidates whose work authorization relies on certain visa categories, or support future H-1B sponsorship at this time
